title: CryptoMarketPredictionPlatform_Schema_v2.2
description: Production database schema adhering strictly to Game Rules v2.2 (PostgreSQL / Relational & Document mapped).

users.description: User profiles. Section 1: Real names private; public display name used across app.

columns.name: username
columns.description: Public display name for leaderboards, round chat, and profile.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: Private: Stored for prize claim & KYC only.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Private: Stored for prize claim & KYC only.

columns.name: kyc_status
columns.description: Section 1: Required prior to receiving or withdrawing cash prizes.

columns.name: payout_wallet_address
columns.description: Verified IBAN or crypto wallet for cash payouts.

tokens.description: User token balances and cycle tracking. Sections 3, 4, 21, 22.

columns.name: balance
columns.description: Section 3: 5 welcome tokens credited upon first login.

columns.name: current_streak_day
columns.description: Day in 7-day streak cycle (1 to 7). Grants Day 1: 1, ..., Day 7: 7 tokens.

columns.name: last_prediction_date
columns.description: Used to verify >=1 daily prediction requirement to preserve streak (Section 22).

columns.name: last_daily_claim_at
columns.description: Tracks daily +2 token reward claim.

columns.name: weekly_cycle_id
columns.description: Format YYYY-WW. Identifies current 7-day gaming cycle.

columns.name: cycle_expires_at
columns.description: Section 22: Unused tokens reset/expire at beginning of next cycle.

token_transactions.description: Immutable ledger of all token credits and consumptions.

columns.name: amount
columns.description: +ve for reward, -1 for prediction

columns.name: reference_id
columns.description: e.g. prediction_id or referral_user_id

rounds.description: Daily tournament rounds adhering strictly to Europe/Amsterdam time boundaries. Sections 7, 10, 14, 15.

columns.name: round_date
columns.description: Target competition date in Europe/Amsterdam.

columns.name: open_time_amsterdam
columns.description: 12:00:00 Europe/Amsterdam: Window opens.

columns.name: lock_freeze_time_amsterdam
columns.description: 20:00:00 Europe/Amsterdam: Round locks, settlement price frozen, submissions unmasked.

columns.name: announcement_time_amsterdam
columns.description: 22:00:00 Europe/Amsterdam: Official rankings and prizes published.

columns.name: official_settlement_price
columns.description: Section 14: Frozen median value of valid exchange quotes at exactly 20:00:00.

columns.name: median_calculation_data
columns.description: Quotes collected from Coinbase, Binance, Kraken at 20:00:00.

columns.name: audit_merkle_root
columns.description: Cryptographic commitment for reproducibility (Section 28).

predictions.description: Section 5 & 6: Immutable user predictions. Cannot be edited, cancelled, or refunded.

columns.name: predicted_price
columns.description: Section 5: Maximum 2 decimal places in asset currency (USD).

columns.name: submitted_at
columns.description: High-precision timestamp.

columns.name: submitted_timestamp_ms
columns.description: Section 18: Exact millisecond epoch used as tie-breaker for identical errors.

columns.name: is_immutable
columns.description: Section 6: Immutable by users and admins.

columns.name: absolute_error
columns.description: Section 16: |predicted_price - official_settlement_price| calculated post 20:00.

columns.name: final_rank
columns.description: Section 17: Lowest to highest error, timestamp tie-breaker.

columns.name: prize_reward_type
columns.description: Section 19: Ranks 1-30 CASH, Ranks 31-100 NON_CASH.

columns.name: prize_cash_amount
columns.description: Sections 19 & 20: 100% of defined pool allocated.
